bank_name: Global Islami Bank PLC (formerly NRB Global Bank Limited)
period_note: Sourced from the bank's 'ANNUAL REPORT 2024'. Auditor's report signed 9-12 July 2025, filed alongside the FY2023 'Revised' report in the same week (both well over a year after their respective fiscal year-ends), and the 12th AGM (covering this FY2024 report) was held 21 September 2025 per DSE's company page. Solo basis throughout, same as 2013-2023. The FY2023 comparative column in this report reproduces gib-annual-report-2023.txt's own FY2023 figures exactly to the Taka (total assets 174,222,009,473; total liabilities 183,248,186,109; equity -9,026,176,636; deposits 130,061,765,565; investment 131,411,917,052; other assets 15,930,713,029; CRAR -9.28%) -- no restatement found between the two reports. FY2024 deepens FY2023's crisis: net loss of BDT -12,466.18m (vs -21,520.25m in FY2023) took Shareholders' Equity to -21,492.36m (from -9,026.18m), CRAR worsened to -11.00%, and the NPL-equivalent ratio (Ratio of Non-Performing Investments) rocketed to 90.72% of gross investment (from 25.07% in FY2023) -- non-performing investments of BDT 130,885.70m against gross investment of only BDT 144,278.12m. Note 14.7 discloses that, per Bangladesh Bank letter no. DBI-6/51(3)/2025-480 dated 14 May 2025, the bank's required provision was BDT 113,583.89m against BDT 24,772.46m actually maintained -- a shortfall of BDT 88,811.43m for which the bank applied for, and was granted (per DOS letter ref# DOS(CAMS)1157/41(DIVIDEND)/2025-3299), regulatory deferral. Since equity is already negative, this shortfall cannot be meaningfully expressed as a multiple of equity the way it is for solvent banks in this dataset (e.g. ISLAMIBANK) -- it is recorded here as an absolute figure only. profit_before_tax and tax_expense are again calculated_from_pl_components for the same pdftotext label-loss reason as FY2023 (see that year's period_note); both are independently confirmed the same three ways: correct P&L position, profit_before_tax = operating_profit (-8,027.84m) minus provision_charge (4,399.82m) = -12,427.66m exactly, and profit_before_tax minus tax_expense (38.52m) = -12,466.18m, matching the explicitly-labeled 'Net profit after tax'. ROE: per the same negative-equity-breaks-ROE reasoning as FY2023 (period-end equity is negative, and PAT is also negative, so PAT/equity would be nonsensically positive), roe_pct is recorded as null in ratios_timeseries.json. For reference only, the bank's own Highlights table reports ROE of -81.70% for FY2024 on an average-equity basis (average of FY2023's -9,026.18m and FY2024's -21,492.36m = -15,259.27m, itself negative, so the bank's own average-equity convention also breaks down here in the opposite direction from FY2023 -- loss divided by negative average equity gives a plausible-looking negative percentage that is arithmetically just as compromised as period-end would be). Neither convention is stored as this dataset's roe_pct for FY2024.
